headline: Ministry of Tourism and Netflix Partner to Showcase India's Tourism Experiences Through the Power of Storytelling
fullText:
Ministry of Tourism

Ministry of Tourism and Netflix Partner to Showcase India's Tourism Experiences Through the Power of Storytelling

Cinema is more than entertainment; it is a bridge to culture, heritage and tourism: Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat

05 AUG 2026 10:44PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Tourism in collaboration with Ministry of Culture and Netflix, today hosted a special event to commemorate a decade of Netflix in India, celebrating the power of storytelling in connecting global audiences with India's rich cultural heritage, diverse landscapes and tourism experiences.

The event brought together Minister for Culture and Tourism Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat and Netflix Co-Chief Executive Officer Mr. Ted Sarandos for a fireside conversation at the National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA), New Delhi. The discussion explored how authentic storytelling can inspire travel, foster deeper cultural understanding and strengthen India's global soft power by showcasing the country's unique destinations and traditions.

As part of the collaboration, the Ministry of Tourism has integrated "As Seen on Netflix" with the Incredible India digital platform, enabling travellers to discover destinations across India that have been featured in popular Netflix titles. The initiative celebrates India's breathtaking landscapes, vibrant festivals, rich cultural heritage, diverse wildlife and iconic locations, while encouraging audiences to transform their on-screen experiences into real-world journeys.

Addressing the gathering, Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, Minister of Tourism and Culture said, "Cinema is more than entertainment; it is a bridge to culture, heritage and tourism. Every Indian story has the potential to inspire someone, somewhere in the world, to experience India.

Our partnership with Netflix, including the 'As Seen on Netflix' integration on the Incredible India portal, reflects our shared vision of showcasing India's rich cultural diversity and strengthening its global soft power through authentic storytelling.

Together, we look forward to taking India's stories even farther and inspiring the world to visit the incredible destinations behind them."

Speaking on the occasion, Shri Bhuvnesh Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Tourism, underscored the growing significance of storytelling in shaping destination appeal and influencing travel choices. He emphasized that strategic partnerships between the Government and the creative industry, supported by new-age technologies and digital platforms, are transforming the way destinations are discovered and experienced. He noted that authentic narratives have the power to inspire travellers, promote sustainable tourism and create meaningful economic opportunities for local communities.

The event also showcased a destination film on India's wildlife, developed jointly by the Ministry of Tourism and Netflix, highlighting the country's extraordinary biodiversity and wildlife tourism experiences. A separate film celebrating India's rich cultural heritage was presented as part of the Ministry of Culture's collaboration with Netflix.

The collaboration reflects a shared commitment to leveraging the universal appeal of storytelling to position India as a preferred global tourism destination. By connecting audiences with the places, people and traditions that inspire stories on screen, the partnership seeks to encourage experiential travel while showcasing the country's unparalleled cultural and natural diversity to the world.

(Release ID: 2295286)
summaryText:
### OVERVIEW  
The Ministry of Tourism has partnered with Netflix and the Ministry of Culture to promote India’s cultural heritage, diverse landscapes, and tourism experiences through storytelling. The collaboration includes integrating “As Seen on Netflix” on the Incredible India platform to connect on-screen content with real-world travel destinations and featured films highlighting India’s wildlife and cultural heritage.  

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS  
- Partnership between Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Culture, and Netflix to showcase India’s cultural heritage, landscapes, and tourism experiences.  
- Event held on 5 AUG 2026 at NGMA, New Delhi, featuring a fireside conversation between Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat (Minister for Culture and Tourism) and Netflix’s Ted Sarandos.  
- “As Seen on Netflix” flag integrated into the Incredible India digital portal to link TV content with tourism destinations.  
- Initiative aims to inspire travel, foster cultural understanding, and boost India’s global soft power through storytelling.  
- Launch of destination films: one focusing on India’s biodiversity and wildlife tourism, another on cultural heritage.  
- Ministry of Tourism acknowledges storytelling’s role in shaping destination appeal, promoting sustainable tourism, and creating economic opportunities.  
- Collaboration seeks to position India as a premier global tourism destination via experiential travel aligned with on-screen narratives.

headline: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu awards Letters of Intent for Establishment of 11 new FTO in country
fullText:
Ministry of Civil Aviation

Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu awards Letters of Intent for Establishment of 11 new FTO in country

Ram Mohan Naidu chairs Round Table Interaction with all existing FTO & launches FTO Slot App

05 AUG 2026 9:51PM by PIB Delhi

In a significant step towards strengthening India’s pilot training ecosystem and supporting the country’s rapidly expanding civil aviation sector, Letters of Intent (LoIs) were awarded today for the establishment of 11 new Flying Training Organisations (FTOs) across seven Airports Authority of India (AAI) airports by Union Minister of Civil Aviation, Shri Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu.

Forty-one Flying Training Organisations are currently operating from 63 flying bases across the country. With the addition of these 11 new FTOs across seven AAI airports, India’s annual pilot training capacity is expected to increase by 750 cadets per year, providing a substantial boost to the domestic training ecosystem.

Addressing the gathering, Shri Ram Mohan Naidu said, “Under the visionary leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, India has emerged as one of the fastest-growing aviation markets in the world. Guided by the vision of Viksit Bharat and Aatmanirbhar Bharat, we are simultaneously expanding aviation infrastructure and building a future-ready workforce to support the sector’s long-term growth.”

Highlighting the growth of the FTO ecosystem over the last two years, the Minister said, “India has already witnessed the establishment of six new FTOs over the last two years. During this period, the number of training aircraft available with Indian FTOs has increased from 324 to 385, resulting in a 25% rise in annual flying hours across the pilot training ecosystem. This is not just expansion in numbers; it is a clear improvement in training capacity and operational utilization.”

The expansion has translated into a significant improvement in pilot output. The number of Commercial Pilot Licences (CPLs) issued increased from 1,347 in 2024 to 1,652 in 2025, the highest number issued in the last decade, with 2026 expected to witness a further increase.

Shri Ram Mohan Naidu added, “Indian airlines currently have 1,640 aircraft on order, and nearly 500 aircraft are expected to be inducted over the next five years. Meeting this unprecedented growth requires a strong domestic pipeline of trained aviation professionals. Our vision is clear—‘Train in India, Fly in India’.”

The Minister also highlighted the Government’s policy reforms to encourage pilot training, including liberalisation of the FTO policy, abolition of airport royalties and rationalisation of land rentals. The process of CPL examination has also been digitized and students applying for their exams now have their applications easily managed with the Pariksha Portal generated computer number. Also, Indian pilots today are globally more competitive with India being second country to issue Electronic Licenses.

A major focus of the Minister’s address was the DGCA’s FTO Ranking Framework. The Minister stated, “The ranking framework was introduced to make pilot training more transparent, data-driven and attractive for young aspirants and their families. I am pleased to see that the framework is already yielding measurable improvements, with a reduction in Category ‘C’ FTOs and an increase in Category ‘B’ FTOs. IGRUA has also achieved an average of 1,765 flying hours per aircraft annually over the last six months, significantly higher than the global benchmark of around 1,500 hours. The Academy has also recorded a 27% increase in revenue during FY 2025–26 and closed the year with a budget surplus after more than two decades of recurring deficits.”

Shri Ram Mohan Naidu also noted the progress made in indigenous trainer aircraft development through HANSA-3 (NG) and described it as an important step towards strengthening India’s self-reliant aviation training ecosystem.

Concluding his address, the Minister said, “One word must remain at the centre of all our efforts—safety. We must strengthen instructor oversight, ensure rigorous adherence to standard operating procedures and build a deep-rooted safety culture across all FTOs.”

During the program, Minister Ram Mohan Naidu also launched the FTO IFR Slot Booking App. To facilitate IFR training and ensure fair and optimum utilization of available airport infrastructure, the FTO IFR Slot Booking Mobile App has been developed. It provides FTOs with visibility of available IFR training slots across AAI airports and enables them to submit slot booking requests digitally.

The ceremony was attended by Secretary, Ministry of Civil Aviation, Shri Samir Kumar Sinha; Additional Secretary, Ministry of Civil Aviation, Shri Puneet Kansal; Chairman, AAI, Shri Vipin Kumar; and senior officials from the Ministry of Civil Aviation, DGCA, AAI, and representatives of the Flying Training Organizations from across the country.

(Release ID: 2295264)
summaryText:
### OVERVIEW
India’s Civil Aviation Minister awarded Letters of Intent for 11 new Flying Training Organisations at seven AAI airports, expanding annual pilot training capacity by 750 cadets.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS
- 41 existing FTOs operate from 63 bases; 11 new FTOs to be established across seven AAI airports.  
- Training aircraft fleet increased from 324 to 385 (25% rise) and annual flying hours grew 25%.  
- Commercial Pilot Licences issued rose from 1,347 (2024) to 1,652 (2025), the highest in a decade, with further growth expected in 2026.  
- Indian airlines have 1,640 aircraft on order; about 500 are slated for induction over the next five years.  
- Policy reforms introduced: liberalisation of FTO policy, abolition of airport royalties, rationalisation of land rentals, and digitisation of CPL examinations via the Pariksha Portal.  
- DGCA’s FTO Ranking Framework launched, leading to fewer Category ‘C’ FTOs and more Category ‘B’ FTOs; IGRUA recorded 1,765 flying hours per aircraft annually (vs global ~1,500).  
- Academy revenue rose 27% in FY 2025‑26 and achieved a budget surplus after more than two decades of deficits.  
- Indigenous trainer aircraft HANSA‑3 (NG) development underway to support self‑reliant training.  
- Minister emphasized safety, instructor oversight, SOP adherence, and a deep‑rooted safety culture.  
- FTO IFR Slot Booking Mobile App launched to provide real‑time visibility of IFR training slots and enable digital slot requests.  
- Event attended by Ministry officials, AAI Chairman, and representatives from FTOs nationwide (release ID: 2295264).

headline: NITI Aayog Launches Report on “Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047”
fullText:
NITI Aayog Launches Report on “Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047”

05 AUG 2026 9:43PM by PIB Delhi

NITI Aayog today released the report titled “Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047” at NITI Aayog.

The report presents India’s caregiving ecosystem and outlines a comprehensive roadmap for building an organised, professional, accessible and future-ready system of care. It positions caregivers at the centre of the care ecosystem, recognising caregiving as a skilled, dignified and valued profession, while emphasising quality of care, professional recognition, workforce welfare, institutional support, and enabling families and communities to access reliable and affordable care. The report also underlines the growing need to develop a cadre of trained caregivers to address the current and future demand of care services in the country and also the potential opportunities for Indian caregiver professionals at the global platform.

The report was released by Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, in the presence of Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog and Ms. Nidhi Chhibber, CEO, NITI Aayog, and senior officials from NITI Aayog. The launch was attended by the representatives of Central Ministries, viz., Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Ministry of External Affairs, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Institutes, UN agencies such as UNFPA, WHO, UNRC, World Bank, Asian Development Bank, ILO, etc., and other stakeholders providing caregiver training courses/ programs.

Speaking on the occasion, Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, stated that the global demand for caregivers presents a unique opportunity to establish India as a global leader in traditional caregiving, unlock substantial economic value, create employment, strengthen recognition and social security for caregivers, as well as reinforce India's cultural and knowledge-based soft power. He emphasised that the report provides a comprehensive roadmap to strengthen institutional convergence, empower family and professional caregivers, and position India as a global hub for skilled caregiving services.

Dr R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, emphasised that Seva and Samvedana have always been at the heart of India's civilisational ethos, and caregiving reflects these timeless values. He highlighted that a robust caregiving ecosystem would strengthen social inclusion, develop a caring society, empower communities, create quality livelihoods and contribute significantly to the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047.

The report prepared Social Justice and Empowerment Division of NITI Aayog draws upon extensive stakeholder consultations, international benchmarking, surveys, and field visits and identifies opportunities to position India as a global leader in caregiving services.

The report envisions caregiving as a critical pillar of India's social and economic transformation and positions it as an essential enabler of inclusive and sustainable development in the journey towards Viksit Bharat@2047. With the country’s strong belief in traditional compassionate caregiving and the global demand for caregivers, India is at a unique position to capitalize demographic dividend and to explore global opportunities for expanding its care network and skilled workforce.

The report organises its recommendations across several strategic pillars, including policy, professional recognition of caregivers, workforce development, global cooperation, social security, family and community-based care, etc. The Report also presents a roadmap for an organised, professional caregiving ecosystem through a National Policy on Caregiving, and a National Caregiver Council.

Access the full report here: https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-08/Reimagining-Care-Strategies-for-Empowering-Caregivers-in-Viksit-Bharat-2047.pdf

(Release ID: 2295257)

### OVERVIEW
NITI Aayog released the report “Reimagining Care: Strategies for Empowering Caregivers in Viksit Bharat@2047,” presenting a comprehensive roadmap to build an organized, professional, and accessible caregiving ecosystem that positions caregivers as skilled professionals and aims to establish India as a global hub for caregiving services.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS
- Report launched on 5 August 2026 by Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, in the presence of Dr. R. Balasubramaniam (Member), Ms. Nidhi Chhibber (CEO), and senior officials.
- Attended by representatives from Central Ministries (Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Ministry of External Affairs, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare), National Institutes, UN agencies (UNFPA, WHO, UNRC, World Bank, Asian Development Bank, ILO), and caregiver training stakeholders.
- Prepared by the Social Justice and Empowerment Division of NITI Aayog based on extensive stakeholder consultations, international benchmarking, surveys, and field visits.
- Recognizes caregiving as a skilled, dignified, and valued profession, emphasizing quality of care, professional recognition, workforce welfare, institutional support, and affordable access for families and communities.
- Highlights the growing domestic demand for trained caregivers and the potential for Indian caregivers in the global market.

headline: Ministry of Culture and Ministry of Tourism partner with Netflix to showcase India's cultural heritage and tourism destinations through authentic storytelling
fullText:
Ministry of Culture

Ministry of Culture and Ministry of Tourism partner with Netflix to showcase India's cultural heritage and tourism destinations through authentic storytelling

Union Minister Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat Launches 'As Seen on Netflix' Section on Incredible India Portal

05 AUG 2026 9:28PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister for Culture and Tourism Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat today launched the 'As Seen on Netflix' section on the Incredible India portal, developed as part of the ongoing collaboration between the Ministry of Tourism and Netflix India. The initiative aims to enable audiences across the world to discover the real locations, cultural traditions and authentic experiences featured in Netflix India's films and series, thereby promoting India's rich cultural heritage and tourism potential.

The launch coincided with a special event held at the National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA), New Delhi, commemorating ten years of Netflix in India. Netflix Co-Chief Executive Officer Mr. Ted Sarandos joined the Union Minister for a fireside conversation on the transformative role of storytelling in promoting India's cultural heritage, tourism and creative economy.

Speaking on the occasion, Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat said that India's stories have inspired the world for thousands of years and that technology now provides an unprecedented opportunity to take these stories to every corner of the globe. He observed that the creative economy is emerging as a powerful driver of growth by generating livelihoods while preserving India's cultural identity. The Union Minister welcomed partnerships that empower Indian talent, celebrate the country's diversity and showcase its civilisational heritage with authenticity. He further emphasised that culture is not merely India's inheritance but one of its greatest strategic strengths, and that every monument, festival, language and folk tradition carries stories worthy of a global audience.

Speaking at the event, Netflix Co-Chief Executive Officer Mr. Ted Sarandos said that there is not one India but many Indias, each with its own unique stories and traditions. He noted that over the past decade, stories rooted in different parts of the country have resonated with audiences across the world and have inspired people to experience India's destinations and cultures firsthand. He expressed Netflix's commitment to continuing its partnership with the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of Tourism to take more of India's stories and destinations to global audiences.

The Union Minister and Mr. Sarandos reaffirmed their shared commitment to promoting authentic stories rooted in India's diverse cultures, landscapes and traditions while strengthening the country's creative economy and enhancing India's global cultural footprint.

Over the past decade, Netflix has collaborated with creators across India to bring stories inspired by the country's diverse cultures, traditions, landscapes and communities to international audiences. The initiative aligns with the Government of India's vision of leveraging storytelling as a powerful medium to preserve, promote and celebrate India's civilisational heritage while encouraging cultural tourism and supporting the creative economy

(Release ID: 2295242)

India's Ministry of Culture and Ministry of Tourism partnered with Netflix to launch an “As Seen on Netflix” section on the Incredible India portal, showcasing authentic portrayals of the country’s cultural heritage and tourism destinations.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS

headline: Civil Aviation Minister Shri Ram Mohan Naidu witnesses Pawan Hans MoU with Norway’s Noemi Aerospace
fullText:
Ministry of Civil Aviation

Civil Aviation Minister Shri Ram Mohan Naidu witnesses Pawan Hans MoU with Norway’s Noemi Aerospace

Agreement to explore electric seaplane technologies and sustainable aviation cooperation

05 AUG 2026 9:24PM by PIB Delhi

Pawan Hans Limited (PHL), a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, today signed a Non-Binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Noemi Aerospace (Elfly AS), Norway to explore opportunities for collaboration in next-generation sustainable aviation technologies, including electric seaplane solutions.

The MoU was signed in the presence of Minister of Civil Aviation Shri Ram Mohan Naidu Kinjarapu and Secretary, Ministry of Civil Aviation, Shri Samir Kumar Sinha.

The agreement was signed by Shri Sunil Kumar Nagdawne, Chairman & Managing Director, Pawan Hans Limited, and Shri Eric François Lithun, Chief Executive Officer, Noemi Aerospace (Elfly AS), Norway.

The proposed collaboration seeks to establish a framework for exploring potential cooperation in the areas like Electric seaplane technologies, Skill development and capacity building, Technical knowledge sharing and workshops , Feasibility studies.

The initiative aligns with the Government of India’s vision of promoting regional connectivity, green aviation, innovation-led growth, island connectivity and emerging aviation technologies.

Speaking on the occasion, Minister of Civil Aviation Shri Ram Mohan Naidu Kinjarapu said, “This collaboration reflects our broader vision of encouraging strengthening indigenous capabilities and exploring emerging technologies in the civil aviation sector.”

Shri Ram Mohan Naidu further said, “Our vision is not limited to operating seaplanes in India; we also want to build them in India guided by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s Make in India vision. Further the Union Budget 2026 strongly puts forward the government’s vision for Seaplane promotion. It proposes to give incentives to indigenize manufacturing of seaplanes. A Seaplane VGF Scheme will be also be introduced to provide support for operations. If we combine global technology partnerships with Indian manufacturing capability, then we can cater to the local and regional demand for Seaplanes.”

The Minister further stated, “Over the last two years, the Government of India has taken several concrete steps to promote seaplanes in the country. We launched dedicated Seaplane Operations Guidelines, simplified the regulatory framework and also conducted a demonstration flight across the country to encourage the stakeholders.”

Noemi Aerospace (Elfly AS), headquartered in Bergen, Norway, is engaged in the development of next-generation electric seaplane technology and is supported by funding from the Government of Norway for its development programme.

The MoU is exploratory in nature and does not involve any financial commitment, procurement commitment, investment obligation or exclusive arrangement. Any future collaboration arising from these discussions will be subject to separate definitive agreements and the requisite approvals of the competent authorities, in accordance with applicable laws and Government of India procedures.

The initiative reflects Pawan Hans Limited’s continued commitment to innovation, operational excellence and supporting India’s evolving aviation ecosystem through strategic international partnerships.

(Release ID: 2295243)

headline: Good News for Container Train Operators as They Can Operate Across All Routes with a Single All India Licence, Improving Ease of Doing Business
fullText:
Ministry of Railways

Good News for Container Train Operators as They Can Operate Across All Routes with a Single All India Licence, Improving Ease of Doing Business

Indian Railways Simplifies Licensing Framework; Reforms to Reduce Transportation Costs and Pollution, Ease Road Congestion and Benefit Industry, Particularly MSMEs

Other Reforms Include a Uniform Registration Fee of ₹25 Crore and No Renewal Fee for Extension

05 AUG 2026 8:32PM by PIB Delhi

Indian Railways has approved modifications in the Model Concession Agreement (MCA) governing permission for operators to run container trains on the Indian Railways network. Under the approved changes, Container Train Operators (CTOs) will be permitted to run container trains on all routes across the network under a single All India license, with a uniform registration fee of Rs 25 crore, doing away with the earlier system of separate permissions and fees for different route categories. The changes will be notified through a Gazette Notification.

Single License for All Routes

As part of the approved modifications, the existing route-wise categorisation of licences will be discontinued. Subject to approval by the Ministry of Railways, Container Train Operators will be granted a Single All India Licence, enabling them to operate container trains across all routes on the Indian Railways network.

Uniform Registration Fee

The earlier system of charging different registration fees for different route categories has been done away with. Every applicant will now deposit a non refundable Uniform Registration fee of ₹25 crore to operate on all routes on the Indian Railways network.

No Fee on Extension

The approved amendments provide that the permission granted to a Container Train Operator may be extended for a further period of 20 years after expiry. This will be done by the Competent Authority to the same operator on application, subject to satisfactory performance. No extension fee will be charged for this extension or for any future extensions to the same operator.

Relief for Existing Operators

Operators already holding Category I licenses may continue under their existing category until their concession period ends. On renewal or extension under the new license, no fee will be charged to them.

Operators in Category II, III and IV may also continue in their existing categories until their concession period ends. For renewal or extension under the new license, they will pay ₹15 crore. This is the difference between the new fee of ₹25 crore and the ₹10 crore already paid. This amount is non refundable.

These operators may also choose to migrate early to the new license before completing their 20 year concession period. They will pay the same amount of ₹15 crore for early migration.

Benefits for Industry

The uniform registration fee and removal of extension fees are expected to reduce regulatory and compliance costs for operators while simplifying the approval process.

The simplified licensing is expected to encourage greater private participation and expansion of container train operations, leading to improved rail-based freight movement across the country. Greater use of rail for container transportation is expected to reduce logistics costs for industry, particularly MSMEs, by providing a more efficient and cost-effective freight transport option.

Increased modal shift of container traffic from road to rail is also expected to ease congestion on highways, reduce fuel consumption and lower carbon emissions, contributing to more sustainable freight transportation.

Towards a Uniform and Simplified Licensing Regime

The approved amendments are aimed at establishing a simplified and uniform licensing framework for Container Train Operators across the Indian Railways network. The reforms are expected to facilitate a streamlined approval mechanism while providing a common regulatory framework for container train operations under the Model Concession Agreement.

Dharmendra Tewari/ Dr. Nayan Solanki/ Manik Sharma/ Vanshita Jaiswal

(Release ID: 2295190)

Read this release in:
summaryText:
### OVERVIEW
The Ministry of Railways has approved modifications to the Model Concession Agreement (MCA) for Container Train Operators (CTOs), replacing the route-category-based licensing system with a single All India licence. The new framework introduces a uniform registration fee of ₹25 crore and eliminates extension fees, aimed at enhancing ease of doing business and promoting rail-based freight.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS
- A single All India licence will allow Container Train Operators to run container trains across all routes on the Indian Railways network.
- Uniform non-refundable registration fee set at ₹25 crore for all applicants.
- Permission granted to CTOs can be extended for an additional 20 years by the Competent Authority with no extension fee.
- Existing Category I licence holders can continue under their current terms; no fee on renewal or extension under the new system.
- Operators in Category II, III, and IV may continue until their concession period ends; renewal or extension under the new licence incurs a payment of ₹15 crore (₹25 crore minus ₹10 crore already paid).
- Early migration to the new licence is permitted at the same ₹15 crore rate.
- Reforms effective upon issuance of a Gazette Notification.
- Expected benefits include reduced transportation costs, decreased road congestion, lower carbon emissions, and increased private participation, particularly benefiting MSMEs.
- Amendments seek to simplify and standardize the licensing regime for container train operations under the MCA.

headline: LALIT KALA AKADEMI CELEBRATES ITS 72nd FOUNDATION DAY
fullText:
Ministry of Culture

LALIT KALA AKADEMI CELEBRATES ITS 72nd FOUNDATION DAY

05 AUG 2026 8:27PM by PIB Delhi

Lalit Kala Akademi, the National Academy of Art under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, celebrated its 72nd Foundation Day today at Rabindra Bhavan, New Delhi.

The Foundation Day function was graced by Shri K.K. Mishra, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Culture, as the Chief Guest. Prior to the commencement of the programme, Shri K.K. Mishra paid floral tributes to the statue of Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore at Rabindra Bhavan and visited a Timeline Exhibition, depicting the rich legacy, major milestones and significant achievements of Lalit Kala Akademi during its seventy-two years of service to Indian visual arts.

On the occasion, two important publications, "Chitrakar Kanu Desai" and "Kalaguru Ravishankar Raval", authored by Shri Kanaiyalal Fakirchand Patel (Kanu Patel), published by the Lalit Kala Akademi were formally released.

As part of the celebrations, eminent artist Shri Rajesh Sharma presented a live painting demonstration, offering the audience an opportunity to witness the creative process of a distinguished practitioner. The programme was further enriched by captivating classical dance and vocal music performances presented by artists of National Institute of Kathak Kendra, reflecting the spirit of artistic collaboration among India's national cultural institutions.

The Regional Centre, Bhubaneswar, organised a Watercolour Painting Workshop with the participation of students from leading art institutions and invited retired employees of the Centre.

The Regional Centre, Kolkata, celebrated the occasion with the inauguration of the exhibition "Maryada Purushottam Shri Ram", followed by the felicitation of distinguished senior artists and cultural personalities. The programme highlighted the Centre's continued contribution to promoting visual arts in Eastern India through exhibitions, workshops and outreach initiatives.

The Regional Centre, Chennai hosted a painting demonstration and interactive session by eminent artist and Lalit Kala Akademi's first-batch Research Scholar Shri Bhagvan S. Chavan, who shared his artistic journey and creative insights with artists and students.

The Regional Centre, Lucknow commemorated the Foundation Day with a Lecture and Cultural Evening, featuring a lecture by Prof. Sunil Saxena, followed by a semi-classical vocal recital by Mrs. Vibha Singh and a flute recital by Mr. Atharva Pratap Singh.

The Northeast Regional Centre (NERC), Agartala, organised a Serigraphy (Silk Screen Printing) Workshop, during which studio artists, research scholars and invited artists collectively produced 250 cloth bags bearing the Lalit Kala Akademi logo, demonstrating the traditional printmaking process through hands-on learning.

The Regional Centre, Ahmedabad organised an interactive artists' discussion, providing a platform for meaningful dialogue and exchange of ideas among practising artists.

The Camp Office, Patna marked the occasion with a tree plantation programme involving artists, academicians and officials, while the Camp Office, Shimla conducted a painting workshop for students of Kendriya Vidyalaya, Jakhu Hills, encouraging young minds to engage with the visual arts.

Established in 1954, Lalit Kala Akademi has been at the forefront of promoting and nurturing visual arts in India through national and international exhibitions, artists' camps, workshops, scholarships, publications, documentation, research initiatives and collaborative cultural programmes. The Akademi continues to provide an important platform for artists and remains committed to strengthening India's visual arts ecosystem.

The programme was attended by Shri Aneish P Rajan, Director, Ministry of Culture; Shri Rajeev Kumar, Secretary, Lalit Kala Akademi; eminent artists Shri Mukul Pawar and Shri Rajesh Sharma, along with distinguished artists, scholars, members of the artistic fraternity, officers and staff of the Akademi, pensioners, art enthusiasts and invited guests.

headline: Union Minister Shri Nitin Gadkari Confers Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak on 12 Rat Miners for Their Exceptional Bravery in the Silkyara Tunnel Rescue Operation
fullText:
Ministry of Road Transport & Highways

Union Minister Shri Nitin Gadkari Confers Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak on 12 Rat Miners for Their Exceptional Bravery in the Silkyara Tunnel Rescue Operation

05 AUG 2026 8:25PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways, Shri Nitin Gadkari, today conferred the Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak on 12 rat miners in recognition of their exceptional courage and selfless service during the Silkyara Tunnel Rescue Operation. The investiture ceremony was held in New Delhi in the presence of Minister of State for Road Transport and Highways, Shri Harsh Malhotra, Secretary, Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Managing Director, NHIDCL, and other senior officials.

Addressing the gathering, Shri Gadkari described the Silkyara tunnel collapse as one of the most challenging rescue operations undertaken in recent years, noting that the incident had caused deep concern across the country. He said the rescue operation received constant attention at the highest level, with the Prime Minister closely monitoring the developments and ensuring that all possible resources were mobilised for the safe evacuation of the trapped workers.

The Minister highlighted that experts from multiple agencies, including the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, NHIDCL, the Border Roads Organisation (BRO), the Indian Army, the Government of Uttarakhand and technical specialists from across the country, worked in close coordination to devise an effective rescue strategy. Various engineering solutions, including vertical drilling and other technical interventions, were explored during the course of the operation.

Shri Gadkari said a critical breakthrough was achieved with the successful insertion of a pipeline into the collapsed section of the tunnel, which enabled the supply of food, water, medicines and other essential items to the trapped workers. He noted that the most crucial phase of the rescue was accomplished through the extraordinary efforts of the rat miners, who voluntarily entered the confined and hazardous space to manually remove the remaining debris, enabling the safe rescue of all the trapped workers.

Commending the awardees, Shri Gadkari said that acts of such exceptional bravery and sacrifice become enduring examples for future generations. He observed that risking one's own life to save others reflects the highest ideals of courage, public service and humanity, and that the nation would always remember their invaluable contribution.

Congratulating the recipients, the Minister said the Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak is a well-deserved recognition of their extraordinary courage and unwavering commitment to saving human lives. He expressed confidence that their exemplary service would inspire others to uphold the spirit of selfless service during times of adversity.

Shri Gadkari also acknowledged the collective efforts of all stakeholders involved in the rescue mission.

During the ceremony, Shri Gadkari presented the decoration medallion and certificate to each awardee. In addition to the main medallion, each recipient was also presented with a miniature medal. The awardees have been granted a lump-sum monetary allowance of ₹2,00,000 each, which has been disbursed through online mode.

The recipients of the Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak are:

Shri Vaqeel Hasan

Shri Ankur Kumar

Shri Mohd Rashid

Shri Firoz Qureshi

Shri Jatin Kashyap

Shri Shorabh Kashyap

Shri Mohd Irshad

(Release ID: 2295181)

Union Minister Shri Nitin Gadkari awarded the Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak to 12 rat miners for their bravery during the Silkyara Tunnel Rescue Operation, recognizing their role in manually removing debris to enable the safe evacuation of trapped workers.  

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS

headline: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah receives dividend cheque of Rs.22.90 crore from REPCO Bank
fullText:
Ministry of Home Affairs

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah receives dividend cheque of Rs.22.90 crore from REPCO Bank

Shri Amit Shah congratulates the Repco Bank management for setting an example in cooperative banking by securing a net profit of ₹169 crore in the financial year 2025–26, the highest in the bank's history

Success of the bank under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Home Affairs is a testament to its professionalism and excellence

05 AUG 2026 8:06PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah received dividend cheque of 22.90 crore towards dividend @ 30%, on the share capital of 76.32 crore held by Government of India for the Financial Year 2025-26 from REPCO Bank in New Delhi today. Shri Amit Shah received the cheque from Shri E. Santhanam, Chairman, Shri C. Thangaraju, Director – Repco Bank & Chairman of Repco Home Finance Ltd., and Shri O.M. Gokul, Managing Director.

In a post on X platform, Shri Amit Shah said that “Congratulations to the Repco Bank management for setting an example in cooperative banking by securing a net profit of ₹169 crore in the financial year 2025–26, the highest in the bank's history. Today, on behalf of the Ministry of Home Affairs, received a dividend cheque of ₹22.90 crore from a delegation of Repco Bank, comprising Chairman Shri E. Santhanam, Director Shri Thangaraju, and Managing Director Shri O.M. Gokul. The success of the bank under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Home Affairs is a testament to its professionalism and excellence My best wishes to the management and staff of Repco Bank.”

Union Home Secretary Shri Govind Mohan, Secretary (Border Management and FFR) Dr. Rajendra Kumar, Joint Secretary (FFR Division) Shri Gaya Prasad and Joint Secretary (RHS) Shri Makkhan Lal Meena were present on the occasion.

The Bank posted a Net Profit of Rs.169 crore during the FY 2025-26, being the highest in the history of the REPCO Bank. The Bank is continuously making profit and paying dividend to the stake holders for more than three decades. The Bank has crossed Rs.26000 crore Business Mix as on 30.06.2026.
